text:
jordan_cs: FYI — ticket #8921 from a trial user. They report their 50 bonus credits disappeared on day 29 of the trial. Account: rwd-3948. User pasted a screenshot and says promo applied initially but balance now zero. Can we triage and consider a temporary extension while we investigate?

alyssa: ack. can you attach the ticket link and any timestamps? I can loop in billing.

jordan_cs: ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/8921. User says promo `BONUS-TRIAL-50` applied 2025-10-05 and they saw credits removed 2025-11-04 (PST). No billing method on file per user.

mike_billing: grabbing logs. policy refresher: trial/promotional credits normally expire after 30 days. We do make one-off exceptions for system errors or clear onboarding failures. Need the promo id + any server logs showing removal event.

jordan_cs: pasted the minimal audit events we have: `account: rwd-3948; promo: BONUS-TRIAL-50; applied: 2025-10-05T15:12:03Z; removed: 2025-11-04T08:03:27Z; removed_by: promo_prune_v2`

sam_ops: checking infra. I see a cron job `promo_prune_v2` ran 2025-11-04 and removed ~1200 stale promos where the billing_profile was empty. Entry for rwd-3948 shows `reason=missing_billing_profile`. Looks like the cleanup considered the promo stale even though the trial window wasn't fully passed due to initial application date timezone differences.

alyssa: :thinking: so system cleanup removed the promo. user never added billing so it was eligible for prune but this is borderline given they applied promo within the 30-day window. this is on us to make right.

mike_billing: propose a temporary reinstatement: credit +50 and extend expiry 14 days from now so the customer can finish their tests. I'll need approval to do a one-time manual grant and a note added to the account for the audit.

ana_mgr: approve one-time exception to preserve trust. please set account note and mark for process change.

mike_billing: done. granted +50 promo credits and set expiry to 14 days from action time. Account note added: "Manual reinstatement approved 2025-11-05 by ana_mgr due to promo_prune_v2 removing active trial credits. Follow-up GH issue: infra#458 to update prune logic." :white_check_mark:

jordan_cs: replying to user now: "We've reinstated 50 bonus credits to your account rwd-3948 and extended the expiry by 14 days while we investigate. Apologies for the confusion — we'll follow up with details once we finish our audit."

mike_billing: command used to grant (for audit):
```
billing_tool grant_credits --account rwd-3948 --amount 50 --promo-id MANUAL-REINSTATE-50 --expires 2025-11-19 --note "Manual regrant after promo_prune_v2 removal; approved by ana_mgr"
```

sam_ops: created infra ticket to adjust prune: change prune window to consider `applied_at` + 30d with timezone normalization and skip accounts with active trial flag. assigned to infra-team.

jordan_cs: user confirmed they can continue smoke tests, will close ticket after 48h if no further issues. thanks all. :thumbsup:

alyssa: please also include this case in the monthly refunds/credits report so finance can reconcile.

mike_billing: added to monthly report. closing internal thread once ticket closed.

ana_mgr: noted for the policy review. good triage.

(End of thread)
